rows.matrix_requirement: Unsupported operation selectors never execute CRUD. ACL/retention/legal-hold and other unsupported requests leave object bytes, version history, bucket configuration, and upstream requests unchanged. Tagging changes only tags once supported.

clauses.requirement: malformed IDs/part numbers and copy/MPU ambiguity handled
harmless SDK controls do not select CRUD

rows.matrix_requirement: Conflicting subresources, duplicate operation selectors, malformed IDs/part numbers, and ambiguous copy/multipart requests are handled deliberately; harmless SDK parameters do not accidentally select another operation.

clauses.requirement: destination-only denied for CopyObject and UploadPartCopy

rows.matrix_requirement: CopyObject and UploadPartCopy require appropriate source/version access and destination write access. A user with only destination access cannot copy a protected source.

clauses.requirement: all4 MPU operations bound to bucket/key
unauthorized cannot read parts or use uploadID as capability

rows.matrix_requirement: UploadPart, ListParts, Complete, and Abort cannot operate on an upload under the wrong bucket or key. Unauthorized callers cannot obtain part metadata or use an upload ID as a capability.

Standard AWS action mappings and canonical S3 ARNs work. Legacy ESS policies retain their intended scope. An old HEAD-only allow is not broadened to GET; explicit deny remains effective across aliases.

clauses.requirement: changed deny/suspension/revocation enforced at declared cluster consistency

rows.matrix_requirement: Missing/unreadable policy records, including an attached deny policy, fail closed. Revoked keys, suspended users, and changed policies are enforced under the declared cluster read consistency.

clauses.requirement: permitted key cannot authorize denied sibling

rows.matrix_requirement: DeleteObjects handles object/version entries separately, mixed authorization and per-entry failures, quiet responses, limits, and integrity requirements. A permitted entry does not authorize another key.

clauses.requirement: valid signed declared hash with altered body rejects

rows.matrix_requirement: A correctly signed request with a declared payload hash but altered body is rejected before any visible hosted or upstream mutation. Previous bytes and versions remain intact.

clauses.requirement: independent MD5 and algorithm checksum vectors valid/invalid

rows.matrix_requirement: Correct and incorrect Content-MD5 and supported algorithm-specific checksums are exercised independently of the CAS hash/ETag. Declared unsupported algorithms never receive an unvalidated success.

clauses.requirement: signed chain and unsigned trailer applicable checks

rows.matrix_requirement: Accepted signed and unsigned-trailer aws-chunked modes validate their applicable signature chain, length, framing, and checksum trailers. Corruption, truncation, malformed termination, or prohibited trailing bytes cannot publish an object.

Independent signature fixtures cover spaces, literal plus, percent escapes, Unicode, repeated/empty query values, duplicate headers, invalid credential scope, and meaningful path slashes/dot segments. ESS is not its only signing oracle.

clauses.requirement: signed parameter or constrained header tamper denied

rows.matrix_requirement: Presigned GET/PUT, signed response overrides, expiration, key revocation, and resource permissions behave correctly. Changing a signed parameter or constrained header fails.

At least 32 synchronized create-only writers yield exactly one success. Stale If-Match writes fail. Conditional multipart completion and races across both cluster endpoints preserve the same invariants.

Historical versions/delete markers prevent bucket deletion. Racing writes, completions, and delete/recreate cannot create orphan-visible objects or revive old state. Injected delete failure never returns success.
Upstream denied/unavailable/timeout responses are not returned as successful deletes or fabricated NoSuchKey. Failed writes/deletes preserve truthful cache/index state and per-entry batch outcomes.

clauses.requirement: external success/local failure durable restart reconciliation
unknown external outcomes no blind destructive replay

rows.matrix_requirement: Upstream mutation success followed by local commit failure is recovered through durable reconciliation after restart. Unknown external outcomes do not cause blind destructive retry or unexpected additional versions.

clauses.requirement: excluded mode feature zero upstream requests

rows.matrix_requirement: Out-of-band upstream replacement/deletion and stale cache entries obey the documented freshness policy. Served body, size, ETag, and attributes refer to one upstream identity. Excluded feature/mode combinations fail before mutation.

clauses.requirement: control XML limits and malformed XML/dates/ranges safe
late failure closes stream without appended error

rows.matrix_requirement: Oversized control/XML requests and malformed XML/dates/ranges fail safely. No secret or internal exception detail leaks. HEAD errors have no object/XML body; late stream failures terminate rather than append error content.

Versions work across never-enabled/enabled/suspended buckets: null version, delete markers, ListObjectVersions pagination/IsLatest, explicit-version GET/HEAD/DELETE/COPY, and correct version/error headers.

clauses.requirement: v1 records do not resurrect below v2 deletion

rows.matrix_requirement: ListObjects v1/v2 handle prefixes, delimiters, start-after/markers, continuation, encoding, zero/max page sizes, common-prefix-only pages, and malformed tokens. Legacy records cannot reappear beneath newer v2 deletions.

clauses.scope_note: Packed-only composition is a standalone domain test with loose part removed and nonzero pack offset. Cluster harness separately removes actual object and part only on data-a, verifies data-b and unchanged RF2/W2/location metadata before HTTP operations; packing remains disabled in cluster mode.

rows.matrix_requirement: ListMultipartUploads and ListParts paginate correctly. UploadPartCopy respects source versions/ranges and authorization, and completion validates parts/order/ETags/limits using supported local and remote sources.

Multipart initialization attributes survive completion. Concurrent part overwrite/abort/complete, late writes, finalization failure, response loss, and restart do not corrupt the final object or duplicate an internal completion.

Object system/user attributes and applicable checksums round-trip through PUT, multipart, COPY/REPLACE, GET, HEAD, and supported gateway operations. Genuine gzip bytes and Content-Encoding are preserved.
Bucket/object/version Tagging CRUD uses correct permissions and limits; COPY and multipart tag semantics are correct. Tag deletion never removes object bytes or a version.

clauses.requirement: actual request authentication and Vary/cache scope

rows.matrix_requirement: GetBucketLocation and configured region behavior are consistent. CORS rules persist; permitted/denied preflights and actual response headers work without bypassing real-request authentication or overbroad caching.
Special keys and XML escaping round-trip. GET/HEAD conditions, signed response overrides, full/ranged reads, and cold-cache ranges return correct content and headers.

clauses.requirement: existing core/web/CLI and retained standalone workflows

rows.matrix_requirement: Recorded current selected AWS CLI v2, Boto3, and mc versions pass the declared compatibility profiles using normal signing/checksum behavior. Supported matrix entries map to passing tests; existing core/web/CLI workflows remain intact.
